#!/bin/bash
# Auto-bump version + update CHANGELOG + update about.html on every commit

# Get last commit message
COMMIT_MSG=$(git log -1 --pretty=%B)
COMMIT_HASH=$(git log -1 --pretty=%h)

# Strip leading emoji + whitespace so "🗂️ feat: ..." still matches "feat: ..."
STRIPPED_MSG=$(echo "$COMMIT_MSG" | sed 's/^[^a-zA-Z]*//')

# Skip if this is already a version bump commit
if [[ "$STRIPPED_MSG" =~ ^chore:\ bump\ to\ v[0-9] ]]; then
  exit 0
fi
